intended_object: The canonical inclusion ι_i : X_i → ∐_j X_j of the i-th summand into the disjoint-union (Σ-type) topological space, as a morphism in the category TopCat. The docstring says this, and so does its use in `sigmaCofan`.
explanation: The body is `Sigma.mk i` made into a continuous map and wrapped with `ofHom`. That is exactly the inclusion of a summand into the disjoint union, which carries the sigma topology. The universe level `max v u` is the usual one that lets a family indexed by `ι : Type v` have its sigma type in the same category, so it does not narrow the definition. This is the standard bundled version of the unbundled `ContinuousMap.sigmaMk`. The library uses it to build the cofan `sigmaCofan`, which it proves is a colimit. It also relates it to the categorical `Sigma.ι` through `sigmaIsoSigma`. There is no discrepancy and no extra restriction.
